camel_example: aliyun cms PutMonitoringConfig --region cn-hangzhou --AutoInstall true --EnableInstallAgentNewECS true --DryRun false
description_en: Configures the global settings of the CloudMonitor agent
description_zh: 调用PutMonitoringConfig接口设置云监控插件的全局配置
kebab_example: aliyun cms put-monitoring-config --auto-install true --enable-install-agent-new-ecs true --dry-run false --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PutMonitoringConfig

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically install the CloudMonitor agent on new ECS instances. Valid values:
true (default): Automatically installs the CloudMonitor agent on new ECS instances.

false: Does not automatically install the CloudMonitor agent on new ECS instances
parameters.help_zh:
新购ECS主机是否自动安装云监控插件。取值：
true（默认值）：新购ECS主机自动安装云监控插件。

false：新购ECS主机不自动安装云监控插件
parameters.name: enable_install_agent_new_ecs

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: Sends a dry run request without deleting the endpoint IPAM pool. The check items include whether required parameters are specified, the request format, and service limits. If the request fails the check, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the check, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request. If the request passes the check, the endpoint IPAM pool is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会删除连接地址池。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接删除连接地址池
parameters.name: dry_run

Code.description_en:
The status code.

A value of 200 indicates success

Message.example: Specified parameter EnableInstallAgentNewECS is not valid.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: Successful.

false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
